drafts.text: Hao AI Lab's FastRUA cuts a robot-use agent from 11.1 to 3.4 minutes on a cup task. Merging tool-call round trips and moving the arm while the model plans keeps the robot moving 84% of the time, up from 24%. Code and write-up are out.
drafts.why: Measured agent latency fix for real robots with code published.

drafts.text: Two DGX Sparks on one cable show each port as two network devices, and using only one gets about 112 of 200 Gb/s. Naming both in NCCL_IB_HCA speeds prompt processing 26 to 28% with generation unchanged. The fix is in TensorFold's docs.
drafts.why: A one-line config change with a measured speedup that owners of this hardware can apply today.

drafts.text: ORA v0.1 from Hao AI Lab adds cuRobo motion planning and a code mode where models write their own tools. Collision-stopped moves on RoboDojo fall from 14.1% to 7.0%. A dataset of 3K+ episodes from 7 models is released.
drafts.why: Open harness and traces for robot agents with before and after numbers.
